name: @citadel/web
description: The Citadel web frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, statically exported into kb/webui/ so FastAPI can serve it without a Node runtime. See docs/adr/0014-nextjs-frontend-static-export.md.

scripts.build:pages: next build --webpack && node scripts/strip-private-pages.mjs && mkdir -p out/static/fonts && cp ../kb/static/fonts/*.woff2 out/static/fonts/ && node scripts/check-pages-export.mjs
